identification: Arts and Crafts occasional table, octagonal two-board top (split joint visible) on splayed slab legs with heart cut-outs and a triangular lower shelf. Armitage calls it Tasmanian oak, H-69 W-53 cm. Early 20th century Australian/Tasmanian Arts and Crafts style. Unmarked, top has surface marks and rim scuffs.
